task_desc: boil a substance by following a heat-transfer procedure.
learning_text: For state-change tasks, first identify the target substance and a usable container or heat source before trying to heat it.

issue_ref.text: The agent tried procedure actions before locating the target substance and heat source.

task_desc: melt or freeze a material by changing its temperature.
obj_type: material, thermometer, heat source, cold source
learning_text: When a ScienceWorld task asks for a state change, use examine or measurement actions to verify the current state before and after changing temperature.

issue_ref.text: The agent changed temperature but did not verify whether the material had changed state.

task_desc: complete a science procedure involving tools and observations.
verbs: look around, inventory, examine, take, focus
learning_text: At the start of ScienceWorld tasks, look around, inspect inventory, and use the task description to identify the target object and required tool before taking irreversible actions.

issue_ref.text: The agent guessed actions without first orienting to the room, inventory, and target procedure.
